messages:
eli: Quick public thanks to facilities for rescuing breakfast chaos this morning. The cold brew keg saved my brain and the conference room felt alive again. :coffee:
rachael: omg that was me. took one for the team and wrestled the cooler out from storage. glad it helped! :muscle:
devin: yesss shoutout. also shoutout to @toni who ran to the corner store for emergency muffins when the delivery was delayed. hero energy. :sparkles:
toni: muffins were lukewarm but love-filled. no medal needed but i'll accept a sticker. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
facilities-bot: Note: Coffee station refilled at 09:12. Milk alternatives restocked: oat, almond. Please submit feedback to #help if anything missing.
eli: adding formal appreciation: Facilities team, @rachael, @toni 10/10 teamwork.
rachael: pls also thank ops for clearing the booking conflict so we could use the big room. @ops-bot any note?
ops-bot: Booking conflict resolved at 09:05 by ops. Meeting "All Hands Prep" moved to Room B. Automated reminder canceled.
devin: turning this into a mini poll — do we want to keep a small emergency snack fund? reactions = yes or meh. low overhead.
toni: yes! also suggestion: rotating "snack captain" so one person picks up perishables each week. small stipend? :money_with_wings:
eli: agreed. sticker reward for snack captain each week. + kudos thread pinned?
rachael: voted yes. pinned kudos thread sounds wholesome.
devin: huge thanks to everyone who jumped in this morning. quick little gif for morale: https://media.giphy.com/media/l0MYt5jPR6QX5pnqM/giphy.gif :tada:
eli: can we get a round of emojis for Facilities & Ops? :heart: :raised_hands: :clap:
all: :clap: :raised_hands: :sparkles: 
eli: Leaving this here so we remember to thank them in next retro too. Huge appreciation.
